sm_top.sm: Houthi drone and missile attacks targeted Riyadh airport and other Saudi infrastructure, leading to interceptions, casualties, and flight suspensions.
Jordan launched airstrikes in Syria following a church attack.
North Korea displayed over 30 new military assets, including suicide drones, at its first solo exhibition.
The United States approved a $2.1 billion Patriot missile sale to Ukraine.
An oil tanker caught fire after hitting a naval mine in the Strait of Hormuz.
Russian forces used a ceasefire in Oleshky to bring in troops and ammunition.
A vessel was struck by an unknown projectile near the Strait of Hormuz, with 25 crew members evacuated by Oman.
Saudi-led airstrikes in Yemen reportedly killed 14 people and wounded 10 others.
The Israeli army withdrew from Hebron following a military operation.
Ukraine resumed drone attacks on Russian oil refineries.
Sudan accused Ethiopia of launching 162 drone attacks targeting infrastructure, resulting in 502 deaths.
Iranian forces claimed to have destroyed a US-made drone over the Strait of Hormuz.
Russian airstrike on a school used as a humanitarian aid centre in Komyshuvakha killed 26 people.
Russian strikes cut power to thousands in Ukraine while Ukrainian drones damage a facility inside Russia.
An oil tanker violating regulations was hit by a naval mine east of the Strait of Hormuz.
The United States deployed a Patriot missile defense system and refueling aircraft to Israel.
Drone attacks blamed on the RSF hit power and energy infrastructure in eastern Sudan, triggering a widespread blackout.
Houthi forces advanced to within 80 kilometers of Aden, marking their closest position to the city since 2015.
Drone attacks struck power stations in Sudan, triggering widespread power outages.
A Russian drone strike killed a 13-year-old girl near a Vinnytsia school dormitory.
Four tankers were reported ablaze in the Strait of Hormuz following alleged mine strikes.
A bomb attack in western Colombia killed four people, including an infant.
Russian airstrikes hit a humanitarian aid centre in Ukraine, killing 26 people.
Houthi missile strike hit a health centre in Lahj, killing five and wounding fifteen.
Myanmar military airstrikes hit a maternity clinic and school, killing 15 people including a newborn.
An attack on a rebel camp in Venezuela left 19 dead.
Russia launched an attack on Ukraine with 193 drones, with air defense systems intercepting the majority.
The Venezuelan Army bombed an ELN camp near the Colombia border in Apure, leaving at least 19 dead.
A Houthi missile strike killed at least 53 people at a Yemeni military camp.
The WHO chief reported that attacks in Ethiopia have killed civilians and brought the health system near collapse.
The Russian Ministry of Defence claimed air defense forces intercepted multiple Ukrainian drones over multiple regions.
Saudi airstrikes hit a Yemeni port and oil facility, wounding seven people.
The death toll from the Russian shelling of an aid center in Komyshuvakha has risen to 26.
Three Kyiv combined heat and power plants (TEC-5, TEC-6, and Darnitska TEC) stopped generating electricity due to shelling.
Satellite imagery revealed extensive destruction at the compound housing the office of Iran's Supreme Leader in Tehran following opening strikes of Operation Epic Fury that killed
Ukrainian deep strikes in October destroyed 11 Russian aircraft, two Mi-8 helicopters, oil refineries, and defense facilities.
A Russian airstrike struck Kramatorsk, destroying a notable building.
Russia attacked Ukraine with 433 drones, of which 371 were shot down or suppressed by Ukrainian air defenses.
Houthi forces captured districts and ridges in Al-Lahij governorate, advancing toward the Aden road.
Israel bombed a charity minibus in Gaza, resulting in 15 deaths.
